Local OCR assets for on-device text reading. The page loads these from the same origin.
No card photo is sent to the projects that published these files.

tesseract.js 5.1.1
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE-tesseract.js.txt)

tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 LSTM builds
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
Apache License 2.0

English traineddata, LSTM integer model 4.0.0_best_int
https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
Apache License 2.0

The copies under scan/vendor/ are what the scanner uses.
The worker script still contains a CDN address as an unused fallback if paths are omitted.
This app always passes same-origin workerPath, corePath, and langPath.
